title: Dashboard handles problems properly
changes: If a page fails to load, the dashboard now says so and gives you a Try Again button, instead of sitting on a loading animation forever
Requests now time out after 20 seconds rather than hanging indefinitely, and the message tells you the bot may still be starting up
Going offline shows a banner, and the page reloads itself automatically when your connection comes back
Opening a server that fails to load now explains what happened instead of silently bouncing you back to the server list
